title: Cloud Engineer
description: Cloud Engineers design, build, and maintain cloud-based infrastructure and services. They work with platforms like AWS, Azure, and GCP to deploy scalable, reliable applications and systems.

skills.name: AWS/Azure Cloud Platforms
skills.reason: Core cloud platforms used in 90% of cloud engineering roles

skills.name: Docker & Kubernetes
skills.reason: Container orchestration is fundamental to modern cloud deployments

skills.name: Linux Administration
skills.reason: Most cloud infrastructure runs on Linux

skills.name: Terraform (IaC)
skills.reason: Infrastructure as Code is essential for repeatable, automated deployments

skills.name: Networking & TCP/IP
skills.reason: VPCs, subnets, routing, and security groups require deep networking knowledge

skills.name: CI/CD Pipelines
skills.reason: Automated deployment pipelines are standard in cloud environments

skills.name: Python / Bash Scripting
skills.reason: Automation scripts are heavily used in cloud operations

skills.name: Database Management
skills.reason: Managing RDS, DynamoDB, or cloud-native databases is often required

suggestedProjects: Deploy a 3-tier web application on AWS (EC2, RDS, ELB)
Create a CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and deploy to AWS ECS
Set up Kubernetes cluster and deploy a microservices application
Build Infrastructure as Code using Terraform for a cloud environment
Implement auto-scaling and load balancing for a web application

title: Software Engineer
description: Software Engineers design, develop, test, and maintain software systems. They work across the full stack and collaborate in teams using agile methodologies.

skills.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
skills.reason: Core to technical interviews and efficient system design

skills.name: System Design
skills.reason: Essential for designing scalable software architecture

skills.name: Programming Languages (Python/Java/C++)
skills.reason: Proficiency in at least one major language is required

skills.name: Version Control (Git)
skills.reason: Fundamental tool for all modern software development

skills.name: Testing & Debugging
skills.reason: Writing testable, reliable code is a core engineering skill

skills.name: Software Design Patterns
skills.reason: Design patterns enable reusable, maintainable code

skills.name: Agile/Scrum Methodology
skills.reason: Most engineering teams use agile workflows

suggestedProjects: Build a REST API with authentication using Node.js or Python
Implement common data structures and algorithms from scratch
Create a full-stack web application with database integration
Contribute to an open-source project on GitHub
Design and build a microservices-based application

title: AI Engineer
description: AI Engineers build and deploy artificial intelligence and machine learning systems. They work with frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and LLM APIs to create intelligent applications.

skills.name: Python for Machine Learning
skills.reason: Python is the dominant language in AI/ML development

skills.name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
skills.reason: Understanding ML algorithms is foundational to AI engineering

skills.name: Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow)
skills.reason: Deep learning frameworks are used for building neural networks

skills.name: Mathematics (Linear Algebra, Statistics)
skills.reason: Mathematical foundations underpin all ML algorithms

skills.name: LLM APIs & Prompt Engineering
skills.reason: Working with large language models is a growing engineering skill

skills.name: Data Preprocessing & EDA
skills.reason: Data preparation is 70% of any ML project

skills.name: MLOps & Model Deployment
skills.reason: Deploying and maintaining ML models in production is critical

suggestedProjects: Build an image classification model using CNNs
Create a sentiment analysis system using BERT
Build an LLM-powered chatbot using OpenAI or Gemini API
Implement a recommendation system using collaborative filtering
Train and deploy a custom ML model to a cloud API endpoint

title: Data Scientist
description: Data Scientists extract insights from data using statistics, machine learning, and visualization. They help organizations make data-driven decisions.

skills.name: Statistical Analysis
skills.reason: Statistics is the foundation of data science

skills.name: Python Data Science Libraries (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn)
skills.reason: Industry-standard tools for data analysis and ML

skills.name: Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Tableau)
skills.reason: Communicating insights through visualizations is key

skills.name: SQL & Database Querying
skills.reason: Most data science work starts with database queries

skills.name: Machine Learning
skills.reason: Predictive modeling is central to data science work

skills.name: A/B Testing
skills.reason: Hypothesis testing and experiment design are data science core skills

suggestedProjects: Perform exploratory data analysis on a Kaggle dataset
Build a predictive model for a classification or regression problem
Create an interactive data dashboard using Dash or Streamlit
Analyze real-world data and write a detailed report with visualizations
Participate in a Kaggle competition

title: DevOps Engineer
description: DevOps Engineers bridge development and operations, automating the software delivery pipeline and ensuring reliable, scalable infrastructure.

skills.name: CI/CD Pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
skills.reason: Automating build, test, and deploy workflows is core DevOps work

skills.name: Docker & Kubernetes
skills.reason: Container technologies are fundamental to modern DevOps

skills.name: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible)
skills.reason: Automating infrastructure provisioning is a key DevOps practice

skills.name: Linux & Shell Scripting
skills.reason: Linux is the foundation of most server infrastructure

skills.name: Cloud Platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure)
skills.reason: Cloud-native DevOps is the industry standard

skills.name: Monitoring & Observability
skills.reason: Tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and ELK stack are essential

suggestedProjects: Set up a complete CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions
Deploy a containerized application using Docker Compose
Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform on AWS
Set up monitoring and alerting using Prometheus and Grafana
Build a GitOps workflow using ArgoCD and Kubernetes

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description: Cyber Security Engineers protect systems, networks, and data from threats. They implement security measures, conduct vulnerability assessments, and respond to incidents.

skills.name: Network Security & Protocols
skills.reason: Understanding network layers is essential for security analysis

skills.name: Ethical Hacking & Penetration Testing
skills.reason: Offensive security skills are needed for vulnerability assessment

skills.name: Cryptography
skills.reason: Encryption and key management are fundamental security concepts

skills.name: SIEM & Security Monitoring
skills.reason: Security event monitoring and incident response are core skills

skills.name: Linux Security & Hardening
skills.reason: Most servers are Linux-based — securing them is critical

skills.name: Web Application Security (OWASP)
skills.reason: Web vulnerabilities (XSS, SQLi) are among the most common attack vectors

suggestedProjects: Set up a home lab for penetration testing practice
Complete TryHackMe or HackTheBox challenges
Implement a simple IDS/IPS system
Perform a vulnerability assessment on a test web application
Study and implement OWASP Top 10 mitigations

title: Full Stack Developer
description: Full Stack Developers build both frontend and backend of web applications, working across the entire technology stack from databases to user interfaces.

skills.name: HTML, CSS, JavaScript
skills.reason: Core web technologies are the foundation of all frontend development

skills.name: React / Next.js
skills.reason: Modern frontend frameworks are used in most web applications

skills.name: Node.js / Python Backend
skills.reason: Server-side development is half of the full stack

skills.name: SQL & NoSQL Databases
skills.reason: Data persistence is essential in any web application

skills.name: REST APIs & GraphQL
skills.reason: API design is central to full-stack development

skills.name: Git & Version Control
skills.reason: Collaborative development requires version control proficiency

suggestedProjects: Build a full-stack e-commerce application with React and Node.js
Create a real-time chat application using WebSockets
Develop a blogging platform with authentication and a CMS
Build a REST API with authentication, caching, and rate limiting
Deploy a full-stack application to a cloud provider

title: Mobile Developer
description: Mobile Developers create applications for iOS and Android platforms using native or cross-platform frameworks like React Native and Flutter.

skills.name: React Native / Flutter
skills.reason: Cross-platform frameworks allow building for iOS and Android together

skills.name: JavaScript / Dart
skills.reason: Primary languages for cross-platform mobile development

skills.name: Mobile UI/UX Design Principles
skills.reason: Mobile interfaces have unique design constraints and patterns

skills.name: REST APIs Integration
skills.reason: Mobile apps consume APIs for data and backend services

skills.name: App Store Deployment
skills.reason: Publishing apps to Google Play and Apple App Store is required

suggestedProjects: Build a to-do app with local storage and sync using React Native
Create a weather application using a public API
Develop a fitness tracking app with charts and data visualization
Build a real-time messaging app for iOS and Android
Publish a simple app to the Google Play Store

title: Researcher
description: Academic and industry researchers advance the state of knowledge in Computer Science, contributing to conferences, journals, and open-source projects.

skills.name: Research Methodology & Writing
skills.reason: Producing and communicating original research is the core skill

skills.name: Mathematics & Theory
skills.reason: Research often involves formal proofs and mathematical analysis

skills.name: Programming for Experimentation
skills.reason: Implementing and testing research ideas requires strong coding

skills.name: Literature Review & Citation
skills.reason: Understanding existing work is essential before contributing new research

skills.name: Statistical Analysis
skills.reason: Validating results with statistical methods is required for credibility

suggestedProjects: Reproduce a research paper's experiments and write an analysis
Contribute to an open-source research library
Write a literature survey on an emerging CS topic
Submit a paper to an undergraduate research symposium
Build a project based on a published ML/systems research paper
